jobs.description:
As part of the Precision Optics business unit of the MATERION Corporation, we are among the world's leading manufacturers of optical components. Our production sites in Europe, North America, and Asia offer a unique range of optical
coatings, glass processing, structuring and bonding technologies, as well as the
manufacturing of complete assemblies.

We are seeking a highly experienced and meticulous 

**Senior Accountant / Bilanzbuchhalter (m/f/d)** 

About the Role:

For our site in Jena we are seeking a motivated senior accountant with 3 to 5 years of relevant experience who is eager to develop their skills and contribute to the financial health of our manufacturing business. This role offers hands-on accounting tasks, ensuring compliance with German accounting standards, and supporting month-end close and reporting activities in an US based corporation.

This role requires a proactive and responsible accountant who can independently manage day-to-day accounting operations and serve as the primary finance contact at the Jena site. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with corporate finance, tax, and audit teams to ensure accurate and compliant financial reporting.

Key Responsibilities:

- Take ownership of the accounting function onsite, ensuring timely and accurate financial data and reporting.
- Assist with the month-end and year-end close processes, including preparing journal entries and performing account reconciliations.
- Support accounts payable (A/P) and accounts receivable (A/R) activities, including invoice processing and payment follow-ups.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date general ledger records.
- Assist in inventory accounting and support basic cost tracking activities 
- Ensure compliance with local statutory accounting requirements and internal policies.
- Support preparation of financial reports and assist with variance analysis to help management understand financial performance.
- Act as the main local point of contact for internal and external stakeholders related to accounting and finance matters.
- Coordinate with corporate finance and tax teams to support consolidated reporting and compliance requirements.
- Support audit processes by preparing documentation and responding to queries independently.
- Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and contribute to system enhancements.
- Identify and escalate issues or risks to corporate finance as needed.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent professional qualification, e.g. Bilanzbuchhalter/in).
- 3 to 5 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
- Demonstrated ability to work independently and take ownership of accounting processes.
- Strong communication and coordination skills to liaise effectively within a global matrix organization.
- Experience in managing relationships with external service providers (e.g., auditors, tax consultants) is a plus.
- Basic understanding of cost accounting principles.
- Familiarity with local German accounting standards and tax regulations.
- Knowledge of international accounting standards (e.g., IFRS, US GAAP) is beneficial but not required.
- Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel (including basic formulas and data handling).
- Good command of English and German (spoken and written).
- Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple tasks.
- Eagerness to learn, take initiative, and work collaboratively in a team environment.

What We Offer:

- A varied and hands-on role in a dynamic, international company.
- Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
- Supportive and positive working atmosphere with motivated colleagues.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.

Who we are

TK Elevator (TKE) is a global leader in vertical transportation and urban mobility. We provide engineering that keeps the world moving, including design, installation, and maintenance of elevators, escalators, walkways, lifts, passenger boarding bridges, stairlifts, platform lifts and home elevators – including multi-brand modernization and service any place, any time. With TK Elevator’s AI and digital solutions there are no longer any limits to urban mobility. TK Elevator became independent following its separation from the thyssenkrupp group in 2020. The company achieved sales of €9.2 billion in fiscal year 2024/2025. With around 50,000 employees, 25,000 service technicians and over 1,000 support centers globally, we are moved by what moves people. TKE – Move Beyond.

What we expect

- You will promote TK Elevator’s compliance culture and compliance awareness worldwide in close coordination with the regional compliance organization
- You will support the further development and implementation of the TK Elevator compliance strategy, with a focus on preventive measures, processes, tools, and digital solutions
- You will identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risks in the global elevator business, particularly in the area of antitrust law

- You will take on responsibility in international projects, work flexibly on changing compliance priorities, and bring an affinity for IT-supported and AI-based work methods

Who we are looking for

- You have relevant qualifications and experience in the field of compliance, ideally a law degree with in-depth knowledge of antitrust law
- You have at least 5 years of professional experience in a company, a compliance role, or a law firm specializing in commercial law
- You possess high ethical standards, sound judgment, and enjoy collaborating in a diverse, international environment
- You are characterized by strong communication skills, positive energy, flexibility, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented “can-do” attitude
- You work confidently in a matrix organization and interact successfully with various stakeholders
- You have a strong affinity for digital tools, IT-supported processes, and AI applications
- And last but not least, you are fluent in English and German

What we offer

It goes without saying, that we offer attractive conditions such as: 
Working in a successful organization with lean hierarchies and all the advantages of an international group. 
With us, you experience an exciting work environment in interdisciplinary and multinational teams.

scheduled evening shifts, weekend support, on-duty, and on-call
responsibilities based on business needs. Profile 1. Legally eligible

documentation and schematics. 7. Knowledge of semiconductor

jobs.description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for a

Research associate (m/f/x) in Data Science in Chemistry

At the Chair of Inorganic Chemistry II of the Ruhr University Bochum we address research questions in the fields of organometallic synthesis chemistry and homogeneous catalysis. We are an internationally oriented research team that develops new reagents as well as highly efficient catalysts for synthetic chemistry. By combining advanced synthetic methods, state of the art analytical techniques, quantum chemical calculations, and machine learning methods, we conduct world leading research at the highest international level. Automated analysis of chemical data and the prediction of reactivity, selectivity and yield by means of machine learning are revolutionising modern chemistry. In our group we employ data science methods together with quantum chemical calculations to model reaction networks from experimental data, understand bonding situations and reactivities, and identify new catalysts and reaction conditions in a data driven way.

The Chair of Inorganic Chemistry II (Organometallic Chemistry and Homogeneous Catalysis) is looking for a full time scientific staff member (postdoctoral researcher) (100 % TV L 13) to start immediately. We are looking for a motivated postdoctoral researcher (m/f/x) who, with a passion for interdisciplinary work, will support the design of teaching courses in data science and machine learning and strengthen our group in this area.

Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 2 Jahre
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-09-21

Your tasks:

- Quantum‑chemical calculations – perform calculations to elucidate reaction mechanisms, bonding situations and to extract physicochemical properties of molecules
- Model development & validation – create and validate models that clarify structure‑activity relationships and predict properties and reactivities; analyse data with statistical methods and visualise the results
- Collaboration with experimentalists – work closely with laboratory scientists to support and validate data collection
- Project leadership – take responsibility for projects, supervise students, write reports and grant proposals
- Scientific communication – compile results into publications and assist students in preparing manuscripts
- Mentorship – supervise students in their theses and support teaching activities in the areas of Data Science and Machine Learning
- Teaching – support the development and implementation of new student courses in Data Science and Machine Learning

Your profile:

A candidate with a completed university degree and a PhD (preferred) in Chemistry is sought; candidates from related fields such as Data Science or Computer Science with demonstrable knowledge of chemistry are also welcome.

Further requirements:

- Practical experience in quantum‑chemical calculations – familiarity with common quantum‑chemical programs and methods, in particular ORCA, Multiwfn, AIM, etc.
- Practical experience in machine learning & chemistry‑specific data science – programming skills in Python and hands‑on experience with standard libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Scikit‑learn, RDKit, PyTorch, etc.
- Practical experience in homogeneous catalysis – desirable, but not mandatory
- Practical experience with the installation and maintenance of high-performance computing clusters – desirable, but not mandatory
- Theoretical knowledge in quantum-chemistry, machine learning, molecular chemistry
- Experience in research project management
- Experience in publishing and presenting scientific results
- Experience in teaching and the supervision of students and interns
- Language skills – English (fluent spoken and written) is required; German is an advantage but not mandatory

Furthermore, the applicant should be open to team‑oriented work and possess a strong motivation for interdisciplinary research.

Your contribution:
